High-level asks for the call: 
- Walkthrough of the CAIQ mapping (what you’ll provide vs. what needs Q&A)
- Gap items we should expect and any known mitigations
- Log/sample window and access method for forensic sampling (S3/secure share)
- Encryption at rest/key management specifics (KMS/HSM)

Our first-lookup availability this week: Tue 11/3 10–11am ET or Wed 11/4 2–3pm ET. If those don’t work, propose a time and we’ll try to accommodate.

Also, is Redwood okay with sharing a redacted sample of access logs (we can accept an anonymized window) and do you have a preferred way for us to upload artifacts?

If useful, loop in whomever owns evidence uploads on your side.

Thanks,

Hi Alex — great to connect. Thanks for the clear list. We can do Wed 11/4 2–3pm ET; locking that now. Calendar invite sent.

Proposed 30–45min agenda:
1) Quick intro + scope (5m)
2) CAIQ/SIG mapping walk (10–15m) — I’ll run through the matrix and call out items we typically need to supplement
3) Evidence & forensic-sample logistics (10m) — sample window, redaction approach, upload method
4) Action items & owners (5m)

Quick answers to your questions: 
- Preferred artifact upload: secure Google Drive folder (we’ll provide a unique folder with restricted access) or SFTP if preferred by your infra team.
- Log sample: 30-minute anonymized window is fine for initial triage; we prefer gzip'd logs with basic field map.
- Redaction: removing user identifiers (email/username) is acceptable; we can also accept hashed IDs if you need to preserve linkage.
- Encryption: Redwood uses customer-specific KMS keys for Private deployments and AWS KMS for hosted; we’ll cover what’s relevant on the call.

I’ve attached our CAIQ template and a short forensic sample spec that lays out preferred formats and field lists. 

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Sofia
